newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates generally softer.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates generally softer.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were weaker at the short end of the curve on Wednesday, while the six-month and one-year maturities remained unchanged, traders said.

One trader said many banks lowered their swap rates for short term tenors as cash from maturing floating rate notes swamped the local banking system. Some banks, however, were still cautious in their medium-term outlook, he said.
The average rate for overnight money was steady at 10.53125 percent for the 12th session on Wednesday. Traders said they expected Phibor rates to move sideways for the rest of the week.
